prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: In her history of the city, one scholar described its relief program of the 1890s as above all ______.

worlds.passage: In 1893, during a deep economic slump, a mid-sized industrial city began giving aid to families out of work. It kept the poor-relief rules the city had used since the 1840s: a family applied once at the town hall and was handed each week a sack of flour and a bucket of coal and nothing more. The city's accounts show it spending about a tenth per family of what neighboring cities spent in the same slump, and the program ran in that form until 1920. In her history of the city, one scholar described its relief program of the 1890s as above all ______.
worlds.explanation: A sack of flour and a bucket of coal, at a tenth of what neighbors spent, made the program above all "frugal." "Cumbersome" fails because a family applied once. "Fashionable" fails because it kept rules dating from the 1840s, and "experimental" fails because it ran unchanged on old rules until 1920.

cumbersome.quote: applied once at the town hall

fashionable.quote: rules the city had used since the 1840s
fashionable.why: Old rules are not the trend of the day.

experimental.why: A long-running program on old rules was not a trial.

worlds.passage: In 1893, during a deep economic slump, a mid-sized industrial city began giving aid to families out of work. It kept the poor-relief rules the city had used since the 1840s, under which an applicant needed signed statements from a landlord, an employer, and a clergyman, each filed at a different office. The city's accounts show it paying approved families more per week than any neighboring city, and by the time the slump ended only a third of applicants had been approved, most of the rest still waiting on a signature. In her history of the city, one scholar described its relief program of the 1890s as above all ______.
worlds.explanation: Three signatures filed at three offices left most applicants still waiting when the slump ended, so the program was above all "cumbersome." "Frugal" fails because approved families got more than any neighboring city paid. "Fashionable" and "experimental" fail because the program kept rules dating from the 1840s.

frugal.quote: more per week than any neighboring city

fashionable.quote: rules the city had used since the 1840s
fashionable.why: Old rules are not the trend of the day.

experimental.why: Keeping long-standing rules is not a trial.

worlds.passage: In 1893, during a deep economic slump, a mid-sized industrial city began giving aid to families out of work. Its clerk modeled it on the "friendly visitor" scheme that reform clubs in every large city were then praising in their journals, assigning each family a volunteer who called weekly, and that winter's charity ball was given in the scheme's honor. A family applied once at the town hall, the city's accounts show it paying more per family than neighboring cities, and the program ran in that form until 1920. In her history of the city, one scholar described its relief program of the 1890s as above all ______.
worlds.explanation: Copied from a scheme reform clubs everywhere were praising, and celebrated with a charity ball, the program was above all "fashionable." "Frugal" fails because it paid more per family than neighbors. "Cumbersome" fails because a family applied once, and "experimental" fails because it copied an established scheme and ran unchanged until 1920.

frugal.quote: paying more per family than neighboring cities

cumbersome.quote: applied once at the town hall

experimental.why: A copied scheme run unchanged for decades was not a trial.

worlds.passage: In 1893, during a deep economic slump, a mid-sized industrial city began giving aid to families out of work. Its clerk, unsure whether cash or food did more good, gave cash to the families of one ward and food baskets to those of the next, and ended the program after a single winter so the council could compare the two wards. Families applied once at the town hall, payments in both wards exceeded what neighboring cities offered, and the council's minutes call the scheme the first of its kind. In her history of the city, one scholar described its relief program of the 1890s as above all ______.
worlds.explanation: Two wards given different forms of aid for one winter so the results could be compared made the program above all "experimental." "Frugal" fails because payments exceeded neighboring cities'. "Cumbersome" fails because families applied once, and "fashionable" fails because the scheme was the first of its kind rather than a popular model.

cumbersome.quote: applied once at the town hall

fashionable.why: A new design could not be following a trend.
